cdx.afinadores.body: Merchants who salvage Serrane technology. Neutral by trade and pragmatic by necessity. Hesk runs their post at Orrel's Step.
cdx.afinadores.title: Tuners' Guild
cdx.cadence.body: Low, mid, high. Three different tones form a Triad; two equal ones, a Unison; repeating the same, a Reprise. The Hollows hear the music before they hear you.
cdx.cadence.title: Cadence
cdx.censored_register.body: Census of emptied choristers. Watch figure: 4,000. Original figure, struck out: 40,000. Someone has corrected a zero.
cdx.censored_register.hint: There is a figure that does not add up underground…
cdx.censored_register.title: Struck-out register
cdx.choir_end.body: Ildra sang until she ran out of lyric. When she fell, the air sounded different, as if something very far to the east had answered. Two Canticles never went out. Someone is conducting them.
cdx.choir_end.title: After Ildra
cdx.choir_lament.body: An ancient woman's voice sings a single phrase on loop: “The last note weighs nothing; let another sing it.” Beneath it, a tired breath that does not keep time.
cdx.choir_lament.title: The Choir's Lament
cdx.constructs.body: Brass, string and a tuning fork for a heart. They follow orders no one remembers giving: guard, tune, expel. They do not hate; they execute.
cdx.constructs.title: Serrane constructs
cdx.coro.body: A network of seven Serrane Canticles that “tuned” the world: weather, harvests and local gravity. Eight centuries ago, five of them fell silent. No one in the west knows whether the other two still sing.
cdx.coro.title: The Choir
cdx.cylinder_awakening.body: A young woman's voice, halting: “…trial one. If you hear this, the cylinder has opened. It has no voice… it has no voice and yet it breathes. Let it sleep one more day.” Then only breathing.
cdx.cylinder_awakening.title: Latency Cylinder
cdx.desafine.body: A grotto where the crystal sings out of tune on purpose. Someone dug it to keep a single sound: the name of the one who stayed.
cdx.desafine.hint: The footprints end at the wall…
cdx.desafine.title: The Discord Chamber
cdx.discordants.body: Fauna put out of tune by the Silence. They growl, shriek, whistle… and sometimes the whistle seems to hold syllables. Hunters soon learn they react to sound before sight.
cdx.discordants.title: The Discordants
cdx.glyph_1.body: A glyph carved beneath the overlook stone: a rising tide. The first of three.
cdx.glyph_1.hint: Something rings beneath the overlook stone…
cdx.glyph_1.title: Overlook glyph: Tide
cdx.glyph_2.body: It only rings when the wind rages: a root sinking. The second glyph.
cdx.glyph_2.hint: The harps hold something that only answers a storm…
cdx.glyph_2.title: Harps glyph: Root
cdx.glyph_3.body: Beneath a mouthless statue: a spiral that does not end. The third glyph.
cdx.glyph_3.hint: A mouthless statue is keeping something quiet…
cdx.glyph_3.title: Statue glyph: Spiral
cdx.hollows.body: Emptied choristers: they sang so much that their voice took something more. They walk, repeat a bar and forget their names. The more you see, the clearer it is they march to the same score.
cdx.hollows.title: The Hollows
cdx.listen.body: One who does not resonate can hear. Standing still and attentive, the world returns what hides: doors, echoes, quartz veins and the true warning of a blow.
cdx.listen.title: Listening
cdx.mural_absent_note.body: A Serrane mural: seven figures sing around an unpainted octave. In the gap, a circle with a notch. The painter signed with a single word: “Missing”.
cdx.mural_absent_note.title: The Absent Note
cdx.silencio.body: The day five Canticles went out. The Watch calls it sabotage. The surviving records do not agree: some speak of treason; others, of a decision.
cdx.silencio.title: The Silence
cdx.statue_nomouth.body: Statues of choristers with their mouths chiselled away. No one knows who did it; all agree it was done with care.
cdx.statue_nomouth.title: Mouthless statues
cdx.taciturnos.body: The Order of Rest. The Watch calls them heretics. They speak little and take vows by the word. Sil says they keep a truth without knowing they keep it.
cdx.taciturnos.title: The Taciturn
cdx.tarn_camp.body: Three cots, a compass scratched into a stone and a half-drawn map: the lines go down toward the Resonance Crypt.
cdx.tarn_camp.title: Tarn's camp
cdx.vigilia.body: The order that keeps the Canticles and believes the Choir will return if the score is reinterpreted. Authoritarian, but sincere. Orrel Tolm is its warden at the Step.
cdx.vigilia.title: The Choral Watch
cdx.voices.body: When something falls it sometimes leaves an echo. If you listen in time, the echo teaches you a gesture that is not yours. It does not last, but it works. Only one who does not resonate can carry it.
cdx.voices.title: Borrowed voices
